parsed_json.up: Select distinct compound ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human adenosine A3 receptor in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, join assays to target_dictionary on tid, and join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name for adenosine A3 receptor and assays.assay_organism for Homo sapiens. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
